summary: Replaced README.md with the draft supplied by the human, checked claim by claim against git ls-files, git log, .gitlab-ci.yml, the scripts and the GitLab API (merge requests, releases, pipelines and their jobs, project license) on 2026-10-24. Corrections: the pipeline has 26 jobs, not 18; the stage table now lists the real job names (task_files, docs_check, duo_config, task_delta, derived_views, web_data, lint, typecheck, tests, red_check, mutation_gate, semgrep-sast, secret_detection, security_gate, paper_pdf, equivalent_mutants_report, human_only_files, package_docker, package_buildah, check_configuration, terraform_validate, release, publish_image, deploy_cloud_run, monitor, monitor_live); the tools image was removed because no Dockerfile.tools exists; the claim that findings appear in merge requests was replaced by the documented Ultimate limitation; the Duo flows (Developer, Fix CI/CD Pipeline, Code Review) are Planned because no merge request, commit or session produced by a flow exists (all 7 merge requests are authored by the human and the only issue is the hackathon welcome issue); the custom agent and flow are not created yet; main being red on purpose is stated with its cause (check_configuration and publish_image fail without the GCP_* variables, deploy_cloud_run, monitor and monitor_live are skipped); monitor does not run in merge request pipelines; the 500 credits claim is cited to ADR 0007; the SCI formula was checked on sci.greensoftware.foundation (SCI = (O + M) per R, O = E x I) and the ISO number could not be confirmed there, so it is not stated; evidence for the Oct 5 table is commits 8f29bb3 and 2f696fe, merge requests !1 to !6 and releases v0.9, v0.15 and v0.20. The run commands were executed (pip install --group dev, ruff, mypy, pytest, check_docs, build_state, mock_dashboard) and the service was started with uvicorn and answered /health, /api/state and /api/ask. The project tree was regenerated from git ls-files. Placeholders left on purpose: DEVPOST_URL, DEMO_VIDEO_URL, CLOUD_RUN_URL. Content of the previous README that the new one drops: the dashboard screenshots section, why use it, the optional project assistant, the index, getting started, daily workflow and the paper rebuild section (the draft did not include them).
